integrity: Analytic proof of asymptotic coefficient and moment threshold; finite numerical and geometric checks are independent corroboration, not an infinity certificate.
scientific_limitations: Fixed n>=3 and Dirichlet alpha>0; area is conditioned on a bounded tangent polygon; only first-order large-area tail is established. The earlier 2015 direct model source was accessible only in abstract; historical priority is provisional.
title: A universal Pareto tail for areas of Dirichlet-spaced circumscribed polygons
